sentences.text: No: for this floating-rate personal loan to an individual, pre-payment charges are not permitted.
The Directions also state that a UCB shall not levy any charges or fees retrospectively at the time of pre-payment of loans that were waived off earlier by the UCB.
The Directions require any pre-payment charge to be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and they say no undisclosed pre-payment charges shall be charged by a UCB.
